question: Should the Windows companion app adopt this persisted OTLP diagnostics endpoint and the future telemetry boundary defined in docs/TELEMETRY.md?
rationale: Tests and proof establish implementation quality, but cannot decide the permanent outbound-network, plaintext transport, dependency, sensitive-data, and future-instrumentation contract.

options.title: Approve constrained telemetry
options.body: Accept the opt-in probe and documented allowlist after the status wording is corrected, with future exported fields reviewed against this policy.

options.title: Land helpers without export
options.body: Keep the shared ActivitySource and Meter helpers while deferring persisted endpoints, exporter dependencies, and outbound behavior.

options.title: Defer observability direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers approve a broader Windows observability and privacy roadmap.

recommendation.title: Approve constrained telemetry
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in probe and documented allowlist after the status wording is corrected, with future exported fields reviewed against this policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The diagnostics surface, initial settings structure, and tray dependency foundation most strongly trace to his merged work.
